Attached: 1 image

Today’s after work run stats in the image and below. 

Students had a course deadline today at 16.00. Then I pressed a button in my custom Swift/SwiftUI app which then pulled 200 remote repositories to my test machine. After the run, sauna, dinner and taking the garbage out I pressed another button which then started to execute five JUnit test classes with several tests on each of the submissions. On Monday I’ll see how it went. All implement by hand. 

7.10 km, 51 m 10 s, average pace 7’11”/km. 
☁️ 1°C sunrise at 9.12 sunset at 14.53,  5 h 41 mins of daylight. 

#running #programming #swiftlang
